reviews.x: Fast shipping, lashes are exactly like the picture and the best part.. it’s actually 2 pairs instead of 1, great bargain. The eyeliner makes the lashes super easy to use, good quality product, cute storage case. I would recommend these to a friend.
Love these lashes .. they last all day and look amazing.. so many compliments.. love the packaging as well

Very realistic. If you are looking for the fake look, these are not the winner. But they are actually very easy to put on, my advice is to make sure you put them on before the eyeliner is completely dry. They will last all day. I am a teacher and I wear them to work, they are not over-the-top, but they look fantastic!
Super easy, dirst apply the eyeliner then the lashes, definitely might buy some more
Lasted all day long through my sisters wedding and crying!  Would highly recommend.

reviews.t: Product is well made but magnetic lashes are very difficult to apply
reviews.x: I’ve been a strip lash wearer for many years. I wanted to try out magnetic lashes. This set looks really good, you get one pair. Top and bottom Lashes are need it to apply for each eye.  IMO, They are difficult to apply and TBH, it wasn’t worth the hassle. It’s very difficult to get the magnet close to your lash line. The product was well-made, however I will be sticking to my strip lashes with glue. The eyeliner and tweezers it comes with it also OK. I don’t have plans to use eyeliner as I’m no

Two stars because it was fun to play with originally. I wore this for HOURS each time and the same thing happened with and without makeup primer. The magnets pull off the magnetic eyeliner at the edges. It was so awkward. If I left them on, every helpful girl would keep telling “you need to re-glue the corner”. If I took them off, my eyeliner was missing the section they pulled off. I do not have oily skin but I am one of those people that sweats easily. Maybe that was why. So if you easily swea

These did not work for me at all.  I tried waiting for the liner to dry, I tried it right away while it was wet, tried it while it was a little tacky.  Tried it with shadow on, clean lashes...pretty much every combination I could think of.  Either way, the lashes adhered to the liner pretty well, although they did not blend very well like other lashes do.  However, the liner did not adhere to my lids and the lashes would come off within 5 minutes or so pulling the liner off with them.

reviews.t: Not worth $15, too expensive for a cheap quality
reviews.x: I bought it for my baby shower. It comes with two pair, I only tried One pair. And I am not impressed but frustrated. The tip of the eyelashes wont stick. I have to keep putting Eyeliner like 4x before it worked, after two hours of wearing it, Party isn’t yet and it came off again. So I took it all off. Not worth $15. cheap made. I wish I can send it back and get my money back.

Mom got this although I told her it was going to be a waste, she wasn’t able to put them on, they don’t stick, she even tried to follow YouTube videos on how to use but even the YouTuber couldn’t make them stick lol, don’t waste your money!

Eyeliner comes off with the lash if you have to adjust the position of the lashes. The lashes were coming off at the corners within 2 hours. I wear liquid eyeliner already so I know how to use, that wasn't the issue.
The eye liner was clumpy, kind of to be expected, and the lashes are all out of shape. One lash held on ok, but the other would only hold on half the way.
The liner is hardly magnetic. The fact it wants u to apply the lashes while still wet tells me its kore of a glue than magnetic eye liner.
Received only one pair of lashes not two as description states.  Eyeliner was open and had spilled all over and was empty.
Worst magnetic lashes . They would come off if I blew on them and didn’t wanna stay in place. Awful product
I would give zero stars if I could. Waste of money. Lashes dont hold with the liner.
There was only one pair not two as advertised. They did not stick or work.
Very hard to get eyeliner even and could not get edges to stick
Once the eyeliner dried they went on easily.

reviews.t: Easy to apply and stayed on strong.
reviews.x: I've only used false eyelashes a few times in my life.  I bought these for a recent trip to Las Vegas.  They were very easy to apply, stayed on all day and into the night with no worries.  They were that little extra pop I was looking for to step it up for a night in 'Sun City'!  The bonus was how easy they were to remove.  With no gooey glue to deal with they came right off with no tugging or eyelash loss.

I only received one pair of lashes, when it clearly says 2 pairs. The box arrived a little beat up, and in a small test, with the magnetic eyeliner it did not hold. I’m giving it two stars because it is pretty, comes with a nice compact case with a mirror, along with the lash tool.  Just wish I got the second pair. That’s why I paid $20

reviews.t: A great, natural, non-permanent way to wear false eyelashes
reviews.x: I love trying false eyelashes. This was the first time I tried magnetic ones and I wasn’t sure how they would work. I was pleasantly surprised at how easy they were to use. I had to try a few times to get them on just right. Once I figured it out I loved them and wanted to try all different styles!

I was sceptical but the lashes were soft and easy to work with. Beautiful and didnt look overdone! The eyeliner was nice 2 thin layers and the lashes were in perfect place 5/5 stars. I purchased a second pair as a gift for a friend she loved then just as much as I did. Also great price!

I'm HORRIBLE at putting on eye lashes. They were easy enough for me to use them again. I did struggle with putting them on properly but that's just because of me  not the lashes. I did notice I have to make the liner thicker for it to work. Here is a without & with photo

reviews.t: Easy to use, perfect for purpose.
reviews.x: We bought this for my teenager to use in a school play production. She's not used to wearing makeup and this made it so easy to apply and wear for her. Little to no help from mom!  The products arrived on time and were as described.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the lashes easy to apply and long-lasting, often wearing them all day.
A common complaint is that the lashes and liner do not adhere well, with lashes coming off at the corners or edges.
Several reviewers praise the realistic look and quality of the lashes.
Some reviewers report receiving only one pair instead of the advertised two, or receiving damaged product.
Some reviewers find the magnetic lashes difficult to apply and not worth the hassle.
